generalAbilities.name: Hatred for Secret Doors
generalAbilities.description: Cobblebone swarms have a hatred for secret doors, trick drawers, or anything else that conceals hidden spaces, as such things remind them of years or decades spent trapped within stone. They gain a +5 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Force Open secret doors.

generalAbilities.name: Jutting Bones
generalAbilities.description: The cobblebone swarm's space is difficult terrain.

generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 40 Feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Phantasmal Pummeling
offensiveAbilities.description: Each foe in the cobblebone swarm's space takes 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage]{1d6 bludgeoning damage and 1d6 void damage} (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw).

offensiveAbilities.name: Settlement Bound
offensiveAbilities.description: A typical cobblebone swarm must remain in the settlement where it originated and can travel no farther than 1 mile from it without falling apart into component pieces, reviving if its pieces are returned to this area. Occasionally, cobblebone swarms are bound to a specific building, road, or district, rather than a settlement.

cantrips.name: Ghost Sound
cantrips.description:
You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.
